title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-29
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a short but fiery 1969 set, highlighted by R&B‑heavy gems like Casey Jones, New Orleans and an epic Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about the performance – a concise ten‑song set that bursts with Pigpen’s R&B spirit, Garcia’s enthusiastic vocals on “Good Lovin’”, and a long, soaring “Lovelight”. The soundboard source is praised as clear and balanced (though listeners note an EQ boost helps bring out the best), making this recording a must‑have for ’69 collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4–5) and detailed praise of both the musical performance and sound quality indicate an excellent show with a good‑to‑excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix praised as "great sound"; reviewers suggest using EQ to enhance the playback, indicating the source is solid but benefits from a little tonal shaping.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A brief ten‑song set that feels tight and energetic, leaning heavily into R&B territory thanks to Pigpen’s influence; the pacing is praised as lively with no noticeable lulls.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia dives into the R&B vibe, even singing "Good Lovin'", and his guitar/voice work is noted as enthusiastic.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ adds a precious R&B dimension that reviewers miss and celebrate.
